answer: Bonded open appeal resists sybil grading rings: any observer may challenge a suspicious verdict by posting a bond, triggering an independent re-grade; if the verdict is overturned, the challenger is paid from the slashed stakes of the graders who passed it. A ring that velvet-smoothly approves its own members' work now faces the whole river of honest watchers, each able to profit by exposing a bad pass. The terrace of past verdicts stays open to challenge, so collusion carries a standing, bounty-backed risk of reversal.
